note: URW3 round B move pieces (urw3-round-b.md s5). Keys <gid>.<piece>; r = atlas rect, pv = pivot px inside the piece (draw top-left = anchor - pv), S = size in squad cell widths (S = 190 atlas px = 108 css), css_per_px = css size of one atlas px (never resampled), straight alpha. pv_<name> = extra anchors (spear foot, halberd butt/tip). Painted facing as in the sheet; weapon props rotate by code about pv.

dianwei.gate.draw: iron gate scene, CLEAN of impact dust (F7): two crossed halberds, pole + flag, tassels, 4 planted axes, crack lines + low dust mound. pv = foot line = guarded tile front edge. Dust is dianwei.gatedust.

dianwei.groundmark.draw: ground mark under living row squads only

dianwei.halberd_big.draw: big gate halberd prop (swings down about the butt): pv = butt, ex.tip = point; length about 1.1 S

dianwei.halberd_throw.draw: throwing halberd prop: pv = centre (it tumbles end over end)

dianwei.rowhit.draw: row hit on the feet of each living squad of the row; spark rims white-gold

dianwei.sparks.draw: intercept sparks on the gate centre; rims white-gold

dianwei.vortex.draw: taunt vortex under each living row squad (turns 90 deg/s, fades in 300 ms)

luxun.ash.draw: ash mark after the burn, feet

luxun.burnlinger.draw: burn linger on the feet of each burning squad (flicker 0.85-1 at 6 Hz); baked caption BURN LINGER left out

luxun.camp.draw: camp prop (tent + stake ring + rope): pv = ground centre of the stake ring on each living back-row squad

luxun.curl.draw: weaken curl on the head line of each weakened squad (sinks)

sunce.drum.draw: drum layer (drum + frame + 2 sticks, cut on its dark outline): pv = frame feet on the MIDDLE sand band at the lane x; drum height 0.9 S; squash 0.92/1.08 on each beat

sunce.drumdust.draw: dust layer (scene minus the drum layer): SAME pv point and scale as the drum, drawn UNDER it; the hole behind the drum is never shown

sunce.heave.draw: heave on the feet of each living lane squad (height about 1.05 S)

sunce.pebbles.draw: stun pebbles on the head line

sunce.rings2.draw: second-beat rings (big one), pivot = drum feet

sunce.ripplemark.draw: ripple mark under the lane squads

zhangliao.ford.draw: UR ford scene: halberd planted blade first (never flipped); pv = halberd foot on the MIDDLE sand band at the lane x, never on a tile; sand-rim fringe remapped sand

zhangliao.halberd.draw: thrown halberd prop, tip-to-butt = the planted ford halberd (165 atlas px, 0.87 S, same scale: no size jump at the swap); pv = blade tip (flight, blade leading); ex.butt = shaft end

zhangliao.laneburst.1.draw: lane burst variant 1 on each living lane squad feet (alternate 1 / 2)

zhangliao.ripple.draw: morale ripple under each living enemy squad

zhangliao.stunring.draw: stun ring on the head line; lilac drops remapped white-blue 9CCBE4 / FFFFFF

zhangliao.surgecrash.draw: surge crash on each living back-row squad feet

zhangliao.wetmark.draw: wet mark under living lane squads only

zhaoyun.crater.draw: crater under the struck squad (feet); pink rim fringe remapped dust cream EADBB2

zhaoyun.flash.draw: intercept flash on the guard coil centre each time the guard takes a hit

zhaoyun.hover.draw: dragon hover ring: pivot = bottom of the ring on the struck squad head line (bob +-3 px)

zhaoyun.scar.draw: star scar, stays under the struck squad (feet); 0.79 S high at cut, inside the tile

zhaoyun.spear.draw: spear prop: pv = leading point (flight, point first); ex.foot = butt (planted, tilt 10 deg); length = one X blade at the X scale (about 1.3 S); red tassel kept (crimson)

zhaoyun.xthrust.draw: X-thrust scene: 4 same-length blades + star; star centre on the struck squad body anchor; dust curls = passing wake (fade <= 350 ms off an empty tile); rose specks in the star remapped gold-white; RE-CUT: detached blob + specks (< 400 px) removed

zhaoyun.dragon.src: r997 b row 4 (r997_urflip_zhaoyun_dragon_v2_b.png, out/ folder: Decision 574 A, art ROUNDC-GRADE s11.3)
zhaoyun.dragon.pv_rule: body centre between snout tip and tail tip
zhaoyun.dragon.draw: ONE clean full-length dragon, snout right / tail left, cut as a single piece for the code slice-bend (574 A): vertical slices, a wave from head to tail (head steady, tail swings most), flies the eased arc turned to the path; pv = body centre; pv_head = snout tip, pv_tail = tail mane tip (specks below 300 px never set an anchor)

dianwei.gatedust.draw: gate impact dust (cream cloud, streaks, chips), split from the gate (F7): SAME pv and scale as dianwei.gate, drawn UNDER it. Plays once at the slam (scale 0.9 to 1.05 in 300 ms, fade alpha 1 to 0 between +300 and +700 ms). The lowest 35 percent of the cloud stays in the gate layer as a low mound.
